classification.difficultyReason: Use the supplied row-and-column partitions to shade each fraction intersection, count cells and simplify where needed; the taught area model supplies the strategy.

content.prompt: Complete these calculations using the diagrams.

spec.description: Unshaded square divided into seven equal columns and three equal rows.
spec.mathematics: 21 equal cells; the student shades one row intersecting one column.
spec.answerVisibility: No shading or result is supplied.

answer.worked:
Shade one of the three rows across one of the seven columns: 1 of the 21 equal cells.
$$\frac{1}{3}\times\frac{1}{7}=\frac{1}{21}$$

spec.mathematics: 1 shaded cell out of 21 represents one twenty-first.
